svg.title: Pyramid Fuzz DSP signal flow
svg.desc: Input audio splits into a six-sample delayed dry path and an oversampled wet circuit. The wet circuit contains input voicing, Q4 preamp, loaded Sustain and Q3 clipping, Q2 coupling and selectable diode clipping, passive Tone and High, and Q1 recovery. After downsampling, latency padding, scale, Volume and quality fade, native host bypass blends wet and dry. Mono expansion and output metering follow.
